description: Cancel a booking made through Bota. First call it WITHOUT confirm: it returns the booking and whether it can be cancelled. Show that to the customer, and only after they explicitly confirm, call it again with confirm=true. Cancellation fees, if any, follow the company's terms.

booking_reference.description: Booking reference from the customer's confirmation email.

confirm.description: true only after the customer confirmed the cancellation of the booking shown by the previous call.

email.description: Email the booking was made with. Required to prove the customer owns it.

language.description: Language of the conversation, BCP-47 (es, en, pt-BR, fr, de, it…). Defaults to 'en'. Bota also answers in the language the customer writes.

name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel a booking
